data.long_meaning: Deeps (Deep) in knowledge (Moy) or 'Lord of deep knowledge'. This name is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Deep' meaning deep and 'Moy' meaning knowledge or wisdom. The name Deeptimoy carries the meaning “Deep in knowledge” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Deeptimoy usually hope their child will grow to embody deep in knowledge and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Deeptimoy total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
